why_reported_context_insufficient: Reported normalized context is already post-map; without the normalization map the executor cannot connect raw overlap evidence to exact O_s or OI_norm.

witness_needed: same_structure_mapping_ref linking source_row_id, structure_id, snapshot/window, pair rule, raw sum, denominator, and reported normalized value

why_reported_context_insufficient: Reported context may identify a paper-level claim but not the exact source row to replay; row ambiguity prevents deterministic witness evaluation.

why_reported_context_insufficient: Material name or composition is not enough for exact O_s; the overlap sum is structure-specific and snapshot-specific.

witness_needed: OI_raw_sum with provenance to source_row_id, structure_id, pair rule, and formula/code version
why_reported_context_insufficient: A normalized OI_norm is not decomposable into raw numerator and denominator; the executor cannot distinguish successful replay from copied context.
